title: Retry failed introspections and list them as pending in status
summary: An introspection that ended failed because the model could not run is picked up again when the agent can next start, and `athena status` lists any not yet retried as pending. A test shows a failed introspection being re-run. The maintainer is the audience; re-running the two named interventions is an operator command whose output lands in records/, not in this commit.

defaults_applied.how: New tests for the retry and the pending listing; cargo test, clippy and fmt must pass.
The fix is a general retry or pending mechanism, not a one-off re-run of two IDs.
Criteria check a failed introspection actually being re-run and listed, not that fields exist.
One focused change in introspect, status and its test.
Behavior criteria name cargo test as the check.
The check is that a failed introspection is picked up again.
Located the introspection code and status in the repository rather than asking.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: failed introspections caused by the model not running are not lost. Audience: the maintainer reading `athena status` and the verifier running cargo test.
'Once the agent can start again' means the retry runs at the next run or status entry point where the driver is available, not as a background daemon.
Only failures with the 'the model could not run' cause are retried; invalid answers are a different failure and stay failed.
Re-running the two named interventions produces new records, which land via the normal commit path. It is not a source change, so the verifier checks the mechanism with tests.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test records a failed introspection (the driver's invoke returns an error, so the record has status failed and failure 'the model could not run'), then makes the driver succeed and triggers the retry path. It asserts a new recorded introspection exists for the same event. Run: cargo test.

A test shows that a failed introspection whose model could not run appears as pending in the `athena status` data and display. It also shows that it disappears once a later non-failed introspection exists for the same job or intervention. Run: cargo test.

A test shows that a failed introspection from an invalid or unusable answer (not 'could not run') is not retried automatically, or the code states why it is. A retry of an already-retried event does not loop (at most one retry per attempt of starting the agent). Run: cargo test.
cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check all pass for the workspace.

The retry covers the root cause (any failed introspection of this kind, for jobs and interventions), not only the two named interventions. The two IDs 20261014-154713-z9rx and 20261015-234842-fhxz are not hard-coded in the source.
No file under records/ is edited by hand. The re-run of the two named interventions is left to the retry path or an operator command, and the final report says which.
The module docs in introspect.rs, which say a failed introspection is recorded and not retried, are updated to describe the retry and pending behaviour.

out_of_scope: Retrying failed introspections whose failure was an invalid or unusable model answer.
departures: The retry needs a new mechanism across core and cli, and the re-run of the two interventions happens at runtime, so cost and risk are somewhat above the reference.
